dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Ah, hello! How are things? Is there anything you'd like to know about the ores? You can ask me anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your ores...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yup, I've got all sorts of pretty ores with me. Whatever you want, I might just have it here!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Most of them are ordinary, not like those previous gems my big sister has...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the ores' uses?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've never thought about that before... I only collect stones because they're pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Honestly, I think it's funny how people from outside find these ores useful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Seeya! If you do find pretty stones, be sure to tell me about it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your ores...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yup, I've got all sorts of pretty ores with me. Whatever you want, I might just have it here!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Most of them are pretty ordinary, but even normal ones must have their own awesome uses, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation with the clocks?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: According to Mr. Chesil, he'll soon be able to make new, beautiful clocks.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: He even took me on a tour of the place where they process the stones. The pretty stones were cut up into tiny, tiny pieces...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I didn't quite get what was going on, but Mr. Chesil said that those stones will turn into the hearts of those clocks...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Him saying that made me so happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: But he says that he's going to exchange more Mora for more stones...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Mora is very shiny, but every coin looks the same — I don't wanna exchange my stones for those.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Ah, hello! How are things? Is there anything you'd like to know about the ores? You can ask me anything!
